facts.fact: ANINF, Gabon's national digital infrastructure agency, says it developed the IBAGHÉ SME registration platform with its own expertise, launched on 8 October 2024 with the SME ministry.
ANINF, the national digital agency, developed IBAGHÉ, an online SME registration platform and digitised registry, for the Ministry of SMEs, launched on 8 October 2024.
IBAGHÉ, developed through ANINF's expertise with no contractor named, was launched on 8 October 2024 as a public portal for online SME registration.

systems.owner: ANINF for the Ministry of SMEs
